# indiecode Software Solutions

> indiecode is a premier software engineering firm building bespoke enterprise software, full-stack web and mobile apps, scalable cloud infrastructure, and AI automation—shipped in weeks.

## About indiecode
indiecode partners with ambitious startups, high-growth scale-ups, and established enterprises to architect, engineer, and deploy high-performance digital products. Headquartered in Nashik, Maharashtra, India, indiecode serves a global clientele across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

- **Website:** https://indiecode.in
- **Email:** hello@indiecode.in
- **Phone:** +91 91563 67501
- **Location:** Nashik, Maharashtra, India
- **Leadership:** Pranav Patil (Founder & Technical Architect), Rohan Baviskar (Founding Director)

---

## Core Engineering Services

### 1. Custom Software Development
- Tailored web platforms, business management systems, and internal operational portals.
- End-to-end architecture from product discovery to production launch.
- Clean, maintainable architectures designed around client-specific workflows.
- [Learn more about Custom Software Development](https://indiecode.in/#services)

### 2. Automation & Integrations
- Intelligent workflow automation, ETL data pipelines, and API integrations.
- CRM, ERP, and payment gateway synchronizations (Stripe, Razorpay, Salesforce, HubSpot).
- AI agent workflows and automated business logic engines.
- [Learn more about Automation & Integrations](https://indiecode.in/#services)

### 3. Cloud & Scalable Infrastructure
- Resilient cloud deployment on AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.
- Microservices, serverless computing, container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
- CI/CD automation, zero-downtime deployments, and cloud security hardening.
- [Learn more about Cloud Infrastructure](https://indiecode.in/#services)

### 4. Enterprise Web & Mobile Applications
- High-velocity React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js web applications.
- Cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android.
- High-performance, low-latency UI/UX with responsive typography and accessibility compliance.
- [Learn more about Solutions](https://indiecode.in/#solutions)

## Technical Guides & Engineering Blog Articles

### 1. How to Plan Your Custom Software Project (The Right Way)
- **URL:** https://indiecode.in/blog/how-to-plan-your-custom-software-project
- **Author:** Pranav Patil (Founder & Technical Architect)
- **Key Concepts:** MVP scoping, eliminating scope creep, typed RPC/OpenAPI contracts, modular domain architectures, and two-week agile sprint cycles.

### 2. Website vs Web Application — What's the Difference?
- **URL:** https://indiecode.in/blog/website-vs-web-application-difference
- **Author:** Rohan Baviskar (Founding Director)
- **Key Concepts:** Architectural comparison, state management, static/SSR content delivery vs dynamic databases, role-based access control (RBAC), and ROI frameworks.

### 3. 10 UI/UX Principles That Make Business Software Actually Usable
- **URL:** https://indiecode.in/blog/10-ui-ux-principles-business-software-usable
- **Author:** Pranav Patil (Founder & Technical Architect)
- **Key Concepts:** Information density vs progressive disclosure, command palettes (Cmd+K), keyboard navigation, micro-animations, and high-velocity B2B workflows.

### 4. Web App vs Mobile App: Which One Should You Build First?
- **URL:** https://indiecode.in/blog/web-app-vs-mobile-app-which-one-to-build-first
- **Author:** Rohan Baviskar (Founding Director)
- **Key Concepts:** Development cost breakdown, time-to-market comparison, App Store review friction, Progressive Web Apps (PWAs), and sensor hardware use cases.

### 5. From Manual Processes to a Custom ERP: A Real Client Story
- **URL:** https://indiecode.in/blog/from-manual-processes-to-custom-erp-client-story
- **Author:** Pranav Patil (Founder & Technical Architect)
- **Key Concepts:** Case study on logistics workflow modernization, replacing manual spreadsheets with real-time cloud ERP, 95% error reduction, and 5-month ROI.

### 6. Building Autonomous AI Agents & Workflow Automation for Enterprise
- **URL:** https://indiecode.in/blog/building-ai-agents-automation-workflows-enterprise
- **Author:** Pranav Patil (Founder & Technical Architect)
- **Key Concepts:** Enterprise autonomous AI agents, deterministic tool calling with Pydantic validation, human-in-the-loop review queues, multi-agent state machines, and semantic caching.

### 7. Microservices vs. Modular Monolith: Choosing the Right Architecture for Scale
- **URL:** https://indiecode.in/blog/microservices-vs-modular-monolith-scaling-startups
- **Author:** Pranav Patil (Founder & Technical Architect)
- **Key Concepts:** Architectural trade-offs between distributed microservices and modular monoliths, domain-driven design (DDD), in-memory event buses, and avoiding distributed transaction pitfalls.

### 8. Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps: How to Cut Cloud Spend by 60% with 99.99% Uptime
- **URL:** https://indiecode.in/blog/scalable-cloud-infrastructure-cost-optimization
- **Author:** Pranav Patil (Founder & Technical Architect)
- **Key Concepts:** Cloud cost engineering, container auto-scaling with Terraform IaC, Redis caching layers, staging environment teardown crons, and edge CDN storage tiering.

### 9. How Enterprise Design Systems Accelerate Feature Delivery by 4x
- **URL:** https://indiecode.in/blog/design-systems-that-scale-enterprise-ui-ux
- **Author:** Pranav Patil (Founder & Technical Architect)
- **Key Concepts:** Tokenized design systems, Figma-to-React pipelines, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards, eliminating arbitrary magic values, and living component documentation.

### 10. Building Secure, SOC2 & GDPR-Compliant SaaS Architectures from Day 1
- **URL:** https://indiecode.in/blog/fintech-security-compliance-saas-architecture
- **Author:** Pranav Patil (Founder & Technical Architect)
- **Key Concepts:** SaaS security blueprints, PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) for mathematical multi-tenant isolation, tamper-proof cryptographic audit log streaming, and envelope encryption.

---

## Technical Capabilities & Stack
- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Modern Vanilla CSS, TailwindCSS, Progressive Web Apps (PWA).
- **Backend & APIs:** Node.js, Express, Python (FastAPI, Django), Go, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, tRPC.
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase, Firebase.
- **AI & ML Integrations:** OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector embeddings, autonomous agents.
- **DevOps & Cloud:** Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, CloudFront), Vercel, Cloudflare, CI/CD.
- **Security & Quality:** OWASP Top 10 standards, automated SAST linting, SOC2 compliance readiness, bilateral non-disclosure agreements (NDAs).
